title: Cambridge medtech scheme secures £3.6m refurbishment funding
summary:
A £3.6 million refurbishment facility has been arranged to convert an existing commercial building in South Cambridgeshire into medical technology and office space. The financing will support the redevelopment of approximately 20,000 sq ft targeting the region's innovation sector.

title: Period properties with modern extensions listed across England
summary:
Five period properties with contemporary extensions have been listed across England, priced between £650,000 and £3.5 million. The properties span locations from Shropshire to London, featuring Victorian and cottage-style homes with modern additions.

title: Buy-to-let mortgage strategies for portfolio landlords
summary:
Leveraged buy-to-let investment strategies are enabling landlords to scale property portfolios more rapidly than cash purchases, according to analysis of mortgage-backed investment models. The mathematics demonstrate how borrowing can amplify returns, though regulatory thresholds tighten significantly at the fourth property purchase.

title: Jones Robinson acquires lettings portfolio from rival firm
summary:
Jones Robinson has acquired the managed lettings portfolio of Marlborough-based Kate's Estates following the retirement of founder Kate Deakin. The transaction transfers landlords and tenants to Jones Robinson, expanding the agency's presence across Wiltshire.

title: Coastal property markets record double-digit growth
summary:
Several British seaside locations have recorded double-digit price growth over the past year, contrasting with a national decline in asking prices. Bootle in Merseyside leads with 11% annual growth, followed by Crosby and Penarth at 9%.

title: UK property sales hold steady despite economic uncertainty
summary:
The UK property market recorded 27,200 homes sold subject to contract in week 20 of 2026, maintaining momentum despite ongoing economic and geopolitical headwinds. Year-to-date sales reached 499,000, down 5.3% on 2025 but 11.2% above pre-pandemic averages.

title: Scotland launches £10,000 shared equity scheme for buyers
summary:
The Scottish Government has launched a shared-equity scheme offering interest-free loans of £10,000 to first-time buyers. The First Homes Fund will support purchases up to £300,000, with 2,000 households expected to benefit in the initial phase.

title: PRS database to enable council enforcement from 2026
summary:
The government's Private Rented Sector Database will function as a monitoring and enforcement tool for local authorities under the Renters' Rights Act. Landlords face penalties of up to £40,000 for providing fraudulent information when the mandatory registration system launches in late 2026.

title: Franchise group sees growth from Renters’ Rights Act
summary:
The Property Franchise Group has identified the Renters' Rights Act as a potential growth driver, reporting increased enquiries from landlords seeking professional property management services. The company reported adjusted profit before tax rose to £31 million in 2024, up 39% from £22.3 million in 2023.

title: Fragmented data systems increase costs for landlords
summary:
Disconnected property data systems are creating operational risks and increasing costs for landlords as new compliance requirements take effect. Industry research indicates that more than half of UK property professionals do not use property technology tools, with 66% relying on spreadsheets for data management.
